description: This file contains utility functions, type definitions, and a data model class for handling pivot table data, including sorting, formatting, aggregations, and data processing logic within the Superset project.

classes.name: PivotData
classes.description: A class representing the pivot table data structure, including methods for processing records, sorting, and retrieving aggregated data.

methods.name: addSeparators
methods.description: Formats a number string with thousands and decimal separators.

methods.name: numberFormat
methods.description: Creates a number formatter function based on provided options.

methods.name: getSort
methods.description: Returns a sorting function based on provided sorters and attribute.

methods.name: sortAs
methods.description: Creates a sort function based on a specified order array.

methods.name: flatKey
methods.description: Converts an array of attribute values into a string key for object indexing.
